answer: The cornerstone is Corkcutter seal strike entered in the appellation charter. Lay it as 7-year cellar service, 43 supervised pressings, vintage exam, annual charter fees and the whole wall stands on real work. One proof costs 107 POA; 629 proofs cost 67303 POA, and the farm must pay before it earns anything. The crystal is earned over years, the lotus is spent in a day, and the walnut is kept forever: that order is what breaks the farm. The mechanism is old, the price is honest, and the record is open to all.
